text:
Maya (Design): quick copy review: the 'Purge cache' confirmation modal feels alarming. can we make it clearer what is affected and if action is reversible? :eyes:
Sam (Product): Agreed. current draft says 'Purge cache for this model' — folks worried it might evict global caches or impact other teams.
Alejandro (Eng): Tech note: purge only clears KV prefix for the selected model+org, it's safe but will warm up again and could spike latency. not destructive to model artifacts.
Maya (Design): cool — need copy to convey scope + performance tradeoff + estimate for rewarming. also focus order: Cancel should be secondary, primary on 'Clear cache' but keyboard focus should land on Cancel? accessibility question.
Priya (Accessibility): Focus should land on the primary action, but we need explicit warning text and aria-live for toast. keyboard users may trigger by mistake so include 'Are you sure?' text and a link to docs.
Sam (Product): Proposed modal copy:
``` 
Title: Clear KV cache for model "gpt-redwood-v1"
Body: This will remove cached prefixes and stored KV entries for the selected model and organization. Ongoing requests are not terminated, but the first requests after clearing may be slower while caches rewarm. This action cannot be automatically undone.
Primary CTA: Clear cache
Secondary CTA: Cancel
Footer link: Learn what this does (docs)
```
Maya (Design): I like that. tweak suggestion: avoid 'cannot be automatically undone' -> 'cannot be undone' feels too scary. maybe 'This action cannot be undone, but cache contents will rebuild over time.'
Alejandro (Eng): Don't promise rebuild timing. Suggest: 'Caches will warm up over subsequent requests; latency may increase briefly.'
Priya (Accessibility): For screen readers: add visible confirmation checkbox 'I understand this may temporarily increase latency' to reduce accidental confirmations.
Sam (Product): Hmm checkbox okay but adds friction. Maybe only when user is org-admin? who can purge? also permission hint in modal.
Maya (Design): let's add a short permission line: 'Only organization admins can clear caches.' keeps it clear.
Alejandro (Eng): Also note to add telemetry event 'cache_purge.confirmed' and include org_id, model_id, user_role so support can track.
Maya (Design): final suggested copy block:
```
Title: Clear cache for "gpt-redwood-v1"
Body: This will remove KV cache entries for the selected model and organization. Ongoing requests will continue; subsequent requests may be slower while caches rewarm. This action cannot be undone.
Permission hint: Only organization admins can clear caches.
Checkbox (optional for a11y): I understand this may temporarily increase latency.
Primary CTA: Clear cache
Secondary CTA: Cancel
```
Maya (Design): Accessibility/interaction notes: focus lands on checkbox (if present) then primary. Use aria-describedby to link the warning. success toast should be aria-live polite with a progress hint.
Priya (Accessibility):+1: Use 'role=alert' for error toasts, and polite for success. Also ensure color contrast for the warning icon.
Sam (Product): I'll update the product spec and ping eng to add telemetry. @Alejandro can you review the permission/permission-check behavior?
Alejandro (Eng): Yep, I'll add the backend guard and the event, and will coordinate on the checkbox gating.
Maya (Design): thanks team. I'll put this in Figma and add copy to the component library.
UI Bot: Noted. Created design task: D-4217.
Sam (Product): merging into next sprint. :shipit:
